title: [ACCOUNTING & FINANCE] Senior Channel Finance Analyst (On-site, Irvine, CA)
description:
Position Summary:

TCL North America is seeking a Senior Channel Finance Analyst to support the financial management and performance of assigned customer accounts. This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Sales, Logistics, Operations, and customer organizations, providing end-to-end oversight across accounts receivable, collections, cash application, customer deductions, trade spend, and credit management.

The ideal candidate brings strong analytical capabilities, hands-on experience managing customer accounts and the Order-to-Cash (OTC) cycle, and the ability to translate financial data into actionable insights. This individual will play a key role in optimizing cash flow, protecting company margins, reducing financial leakage, and ensuring strong operational and financial discipline across assigned accounts.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Accounts Receivable & Customer Account Management

  • Customer Portal & Account Management: Serve as a primary finance contact for assigned customer accounts and actively manage customer vendor portals to support invoicing, remittance, deductions, dispute resolution, and ongoing account alignment.
  • Invoicing & Cash Application: Ensure timely and accurate transmission of invoices through email, EDI, and customer-specific platforms. Review customer payments and remittance details and ensure accurate and timely cash application and subledger-to-GL posting.
  • Collections & Account Reconciliation: Monitor customer aging, proactively manage past-due balances, conduct structured collection activities, and prepare and distribute Statements of Account (SOA) to maintain accurate account reconciliation.
  • Customer Account Maintenance: Maintain accurate customer records, collection documentation, account activity, and supporting financial information within ERP and related systems.
  • Credit Management: Support customer credit reviews, credit risk monitoring, order holds/releases, and other credit-related activities to help minimize exposure and protect company assets.
  • Financial Close & Audit Support: Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities, audits, reporting requirements, and other accounting and finance projects as needed.

Customer Deductions & Channel Spend Management

  • Contract & Deduction Review: Review and interpret customer contracts, agreements, and commercial terms to appropriately classify, validate, and analyze deductions, short payments, and chargebacks.
  • Trade Spend & Promotional Settlement: Review and process routine promotional and contractual customer expenses, including MDF, STC, rebates, volume discounts, and other channel investments. Ensure expenses are properly matched against accruals and supported by appropriate documentation.
  • Deduction & Chargeback Resolution: Investigate abnormal, unauthorized, or disputed deductions, including non-compliance charges, quantity shortages, unauthorized returns, and other customer chargebacks.
  • Cross-Functional Recovery: Partner with Sales, Logistics, Warehousing, Operations, and customers to gather supporting documentation, submit disputes through customer portals, and drive timely resolution and recovery of funds.
  • Spend Governance: Help ensure customer investments and deductions are aligned with contractual terms, commercial objectives, and company financial policies.

Financial Analysis & Reporting

  • Aging & Delinquency Analysis: Analyze customer aging schedules, past-due trends, collection performance, and account exposure to identify risks and recommend actionable mitigation plans.
  • Trade Spend & Profitability Analysis: Analyze trade spend and promotional investments by customer account to evaluate effectiveness, profitability, and return on investment and support commercial decision-making.
  • Deduction & Root-Cause Analysis: Identify recurring deduction and chargeback trends, map root causes, and provide management with insights and recommendations to reduce financial leakage and improve operational performance.
  • Account Performance Reporting: Monitor key financial and account-level metrics and provide timely reporting and insights to Finance and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Forecasting & Ad Hoc Analysis: Support financial reporting, forecasting, audits, and ad hoc financial analysis to provide accurate and timely information for management decision-making.

Process Improvement & Cross-Functional Support

  • Identify opportunities to improve accounts receivable, collections, cash application, deduction management, and customer account processes.
  • Participate in cross-functional initiatives focused on improving operational efficiency, reducing recurring customer issues, and strengthening financial controls.
  • Support system enhancements, process automation, and finance digitalization initiatives as assigned.
  • Partner with Finance, Sales, Logistics, Operations, and other stakeholders to resolve complex account issues and improve the overall customer-to-cash experience.
  • Support other finance initiatives and special projects as assigned.

These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. Please note that job duties may evolve based on business needs and additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to maintain operational efficiency and security. 

Physical and Work Environment Requirements:

  • This is an on-site position based in Irvine, CA.
  • Occasional travel may be required to support customer meetings, retail meetings, industry research, internal planning sessions, or other business needs.
  • Typical office environment with extended periods of computer-based financial analysis, reporting, and collaboration.
  • Daily: Extended periods of sitting, computer work, financial analysis, account reconciliation, reporting, and communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Frequent: Application of professional judgement in accordance with company policies and commercial priorities; analysis of financial and customer account information; learning and utilizing new systems, data platforms, and analytical tools.  

Qualifications:

Must Haves:

  • Associate's degree required; Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience
  • 3+ years of experience in Channel Finance, Commercial Finance, Accounts Receivable, Order-to-Cash (O2C), collections, chargebacks, credit management, or B2B customer account management.
  • Experience within Consumer Electronics, CPG, Retail, or Distribution environments preferred.
  • Proven experience managing major retail customer/vendor portals for invoicing, remittance retrieval, deduction research, collections, and dispute resolution.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, accounts receivable, credit risk, collections, customer deductions, dispute management, and account reconciliation.
  • Experience with trade spend, promotional programs, rebates, MDF, STC, or other customer/channel investments preferred.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, SUMIFS, data reconciliation, and financial reporting.
  • Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, NetSuite, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes, evaluate financial trends, and develop practical solutions.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to effectively partner across Finance, Sales, Logistics, Operations, and customer organizations.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong ownership and accountability and the ability to manage multiple priorities and critical deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify process improvement opportunities and drive issues through to resolution.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience supporting large national retailers such as Best Buy, Walmart, Amazon, or similar high-volume retail customers.
  • Experience with EDI transactions and retailer-specific invoicing and deduction workflows.
  • Experience managing high-volume customer deductions and complex dispute resolution processes.
  • Experience with credit risk assessment, customer credit limits, and order hold/release processes.
  • Advanced financial analysis and modeling capabilities.
  • Experience with finance automation, digitalization, or ERP/system implementation projects.
  • Experience working in a global or cross-border organization, particularly supporting HQ teams based in Asia.
  • Mandarin Chinese language proficiency.

title: [CUSTOMER ADVOCACY] Technical Support Specialist II, On-site in Irvine, CA
description:
Position Summary:

TCL Customer Advocacy & Support is seeking an accountable, technically skilled, customer-focused professional to own the resolution of complex technical issues, critical escalations, executive complaints, and high-visibility advocacy cases. This is not a transactional support role: it's an escalation resource responsible for driving issues to resolution, validating technical concerns, identifying root causes, and coordinating cross-functional action to protect the customer experience and TCL's brand. The ideal candidate is decisive under pressure, takes personal ownership of outcomes, and can independently assess situations, remove barriers, and execute timely resolutions with minimal supervision.

As a member of the Escalation Engineering and Customer Advocacy team, you will assume end-to-end ownership of customer issues from initial assignment through final resolution. You will be expected to proactively drive actions, manage competing priorities, hold stakeholders accountable to commitments, and ensure customers receive accurate, timely, and professional support.

You will partner closely with Engineering, Quality, Service, Product Management, Supply Chain, Legal, and Operations teams to resolve complex issues, validate product concerns, improve support processes, and identify opportunities for corrective and preventive action.

We value technical expertise, accountability, reliability, integrity, resilience, critical thinking, and a sense of ownership with relentless commitment to customer satisfaction and operational excellence.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Own and manage complex customer escalations from intake through final resolution.
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, validate, and resolve advanced technical issues across multiple product categories.
  • Lead resolution efforts for executive complaints, legal-sensitive matters, social media escalations, and other high-risk customer situations.
  • Perform technical testing, issue reproduction, product validation, and root cause analysis.
  • Coordinate cross-functional resources and drive accountability to ensure timely resolution of customer commitments.
  • Identify recurring product, process, and customer experience issues and recommend corrective actions.
  • Document technical findings and communicate actionable recommendations to Engineering, Quality, and Product teams.
  • Create and maintain troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, and process documentation.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on CSAT, NPS, FCR, operational efficiency, and customer advocacy outcomes.

These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. Please note that job duties may evolve based on business needs and additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to maintain operational efficiency and security. 

Physical and Work Environment Requirements:

  • This position is based onsite in Irvine, California. Regular in-person attendance is an essential function of the role.
  • Work extensively with computers, communication systems, diagnostic tools, and testing equipment.
  • Move throughout the office, warehouse, laboratory, service, and testing environments as required.
  • Inspect, handle, transport, install, configure, test, and validate consumer electronics products and related equipment.
  • Frequently lift, carry, push, pull, and move products, tools, materials, and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds independently, and heavier items with appropriate assistance or equipment.
  • Bend, reach, stoop, kneel, crouch, climb, and stand for extended periods during testing, troubleshooting, validation, and equipment handling activities.

Qualifications:

Must Haves:

title: [HVAC / CUSTOMER ADVOCACY] HVAC Technical and Field Support Specialist
description:
Position Summary:

TCL North America is seeking a resourceful and customer-focused HVAC Technical & Field Support Specialist to join our growing support team. This role plays a critical part in elevating the customer and partner experience by resolving complex technical issues, strengthening field capabilities, and driving continuous product and service improvements across TCL's HVAC and consumer electronics portfolio.

As a key bridge between customers, field partners, and internal engineering teams, this individual will lead advanced troubleshooting efforts, support technical training initiatives, and contribute to root cause analysis and product feedback loops. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on technical expertise, structured problem-solving skills, and a proactive, service-oriented mindset.

This role requires a high level of ownership, comfort operating independently in field environments, and the ability to translate technical complexity into clear, actionable guidance for diverse audiences.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Technical Support & Issue Resolution

  • Provide advanced technical support across multiple channels, resolving complex product and service-related issues with a strong focus on customer satisfaction
  • Own and manage technical escalations, including Level 1 and Level 2 troubleshooting across HVAC and consumer electronics product lines

Field Training & Partner Enablement

  • Travel to customer, contractor, and distributor sites to deliver technical training on product usage, system operation, troubleshooting, and repair best practices.
  • Act as a key technical resource to strengthen partner capabilities and ensure consistent service quality across the network.

Claims Management & Service Operations

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Root Cause Analysis

title: [MARKETING] E-commerce and Marketplace Manager, On-site in Irvine, CA
description:
Position Summary:

TCL North America is seeking a highly accountable, results-driven E-Commerce & Marketplace Manager to own the day-to-day execution and performance of the company's e-commerce channels, including Amazon and key retail partner platforms. This role will translate channel strategies into actionable plans and drive initiatives through completion across digital merchandising, marketplace operations, retail media, promotions, and channel performance. The position will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Creative, Analytics, and external retail partners to ensure priorities are clearly defined, executed on time, and aligned with business objectives.

The ideal candidate is a proactive, hands-on owner who combines strategic thinking with strong execution and follow-through. This person should be comfortable managing multiple priorities, identifying issues and opportunities, taking action with limited direction, and providing leadership with clear, timely visibility into performance, project status, risks, and next steps. Success in this role requires a strong sense of accountability and the ability to drive initiatives from strategy through execution while delivering measurable business results.

Duties & Responsibilities:

E-Commerce & Marketplace Growth

  • Own day-to-day performance and execution across Amazon and key e-commerce retail channels, with accountability for driving growth, conversion, visibility, and revenue.
  • Develop channel strategies and translate them into clear, actionable plans with defined priorities, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead initiatives from planning through execution, proactively managing dependencies and resolving issues to ensure commitments are delivered on time.
  • Continuously assess channel performance, identify opportunities and risks, and take action to improve results.
  • Maintain a current view of business priorities, channel activities, and performance so leadership has clear visibility into progress, issues, and next steps.

Digital Commerce & Merchandising

  • Own the digital shelf across key retail platforms, ensuring products are accurately represented, competitively positioned, and optimized for conversion.
  • Oversee product content, enhanced content, imagery, rich media, promotions, and other digital merchandising initiatives.
  • Partner with Creative, Brand, Product Marketing, Sales, and external agencies to move projects from concept to completion.
  • Establish clear briefs, deadlines, and quality expectations and actively manage execution through completion.
  • Conduct ongoing audits of the digital shelf and proactively address gaps in content, availability, pricing, discoverability, and brand presentation.

Amazon & Retail Media

  • Own Amazon channel execution, including Seller/Vendor Central, Brand Store, product detail pages, promotions, advertising, and marketplace performance.
  • Develop and optimize Amazon advertising and retail media programs based on business objectives, performance data, and return on investment.
  • Monitor sales, traffic, conversion, Buy Box, inventory, pricing, reviews, advertising performance, and other key indicators.
  • Quickly identify performance issues and develop recommendations and action plans to address them.
  • Work directly with Amazon and retail media partners to secure opportunities, resolve issues, and improve channel performance.

Performance Management & Reporting

  • Establish and maintain real-time reporting on key e-commerce KPIs, initiatives, promotional activity, and channel health.
  • Provide regular visibility into what has been completed, what is in progress, what is at risk, and what requires action.
  • Use data to identify trends, diagnose performance issues, and recommend specific actions rather than simply reporting results.
  • Maintain accurate dashboards and reporting that enable leadership to quickly understand channel performance and business priorities.
  • Ensure commitments and deliverables are tracked through completion and communicate changes or risks proactively.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Act as the central owner for e-commerce initiatives, coordinating internal teams and external partners to ensure timely execution.
  • Establish clear ownership, timelines, and deliverables across cross-functional projects.
  • Follow up proactively with stakeholders and partners to remove roadblocks and maintain momentum.
  • Escalate material risks early and arrive with recommended solutions and a clear path forward.
  • Build strong relationships with retailer partners and internal stakeholders while maintaining accountability for results.

These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. title: [SALES] HVAC Regional Sales Manager - Northeast
description:
Position Summary:

Reporting to the Director of Business Development - HVAC, the Regional Sales Manager (RSM) is responsible for executing regional sales strategies and driving revenue growth across assigned U.S. territories. This role leads day-to-day sales execution within the region, ensuring alignment with national objectives while building and maintaining strong relationships with distributors, manufacturer's representatives, and key regional customers across residential and commercial HVAC markets.

The Regional Sales Manager plays a critical role in expanding TCL's HVAC footprint by managing channel relationships, developing new business opportunities, and ensuring consistent product knowledge and execution in the field. The ideal candidate brings deep HVAC channel experience, strong leadership capability, and the ability to balance tactical execution with regional-level strategy in a fast-growing, dynamic organization.

title: [SUPPLY CHAIN] Supply Chain Operations Manager
description:
Position Summary:

TCL is seeking a Supply Chain Operations Manager to serve as a key operational leader supporting our El Paso/Juárez supply chain network. This role is responsible for the day-to-day execution and performance of cross-border inventory flow, warehouse operations, transportation, and customer order fulfillment. The ideal candidate is a hands-on supply chain leader with strong experience in logistics, warehouse operations, inventory management, and cross-border transportation. This individual will serve as the primary operational link between 3PL warehouse partners, transportation providers, Demand Planning, Order Management, Import Logistics, and other internal teams, ensuring inventory and customer orders move efficiently and reliably through the network.

This role will play a critical part in identifying operational risks, driving timely resolution of issues, holding external partners accountable to service expectations, and continuously improving cost, service, productivity, and overall supply chain performance.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Supply Chain & Warehouse Operations

  • Lead daily supply chain and warehouse execution across the El Paso/Juárez operation
  • Oversee 3PL warehouse performance, including receiving, inventory accuracy, order fulfillment, shipping, and operational exceptions
  • Monitor open orders, inventory availability, shortages, inbound supply, warehouse capacity, appointments, and shipment status
  • Ensure customer orders are scheduled, fulfilled, and shipped within required delivery windows
  • Coordinate inbound inventory from Juárez with warehouse capacity, customer demand, and outbound shipment requirements
  • Establish strong operating routines with 3PL partners to ensure consistent execution and service performance

Transportation & Cross-Border Logistics

  • Monitor transportation activity, including carrier performance, missed pickups, appointment issues, shipment delays, and other transportation exceptions
  • Partner with Import Logistics and transportation providers to ensure timely movement of inventory across the U.S./Mexico border
  • Identify and resolve cross-border operational issues that may impact inventory availability or customer commitments
  • Coordinate with internal and external partners to proactively manage supply chain disruptions and at-risk shipments

Inventory & Order Fulfillment

  • Partner with Demand Planning and Order Management to identify inventory shortages, supply constraints, and customer orders at risk
  • Monitor inventory availability and movement to ensure alignment with customer demand and fulfillment requirements
  • Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies, receiving issues, ASN/EDI errors, BOL discrepancies, and warehouse-system exceptions
  • Maintain visibility into inventory and order status across the supply chain and proactively escalate risks
  • Drive corrective actions to improve inventory accuracy, order fulfillment, and customer service levels

Operational Performance & Reporting

  • Track and report key operational KPIs, including shipments, appointments, shortages, inventory accuracy, warehouse performance, carrier performance, and service levels
  • Analyze operational trends and identify key drivers of service, cost, and productivity performance
  • Provide regular updates on operational risks, exceptions, and corrective actions to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Conduct root-cause analysis and implement corrective actions for recurring warehouse, inventory, transportation, and service issues
  • Hold 3PLs, carriers, and other external partners accountable for agreed-upon performance expectations

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve supply chain cost, service, productivity, and operational efficiency
  • Establish standardized processes and operating routines across warehouse, transportation, and cross-border activities
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across the El Paso/Juárez supply chain network
  • Support process and system improvements, including ERP, WMS, EDI, and other supply chain technology initiatives
  • Develop strong working relationships with 3PLs, carriers, and internal cross-functional teams to improve overall supply chain execution

These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. Please note that job duties may evolve based on business needs and additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to maintain operational efficiency and security. 

Physical and Work Environment Requirements:

  • This is an on-site position based in El Paso, TX
  • Regular presence and coordination across the El Paso/Juárez supply chain operation is required
  • Occasional travel may be required to support warehouse operations, carrier meetings, supplier or customer requirements, and internal planning sessions
  • Typical office and warehouse environment with extended periods of computer-based analytical and operational work
  • May require occasional time in warehouse, loading, receiving, and distribution areas

Cognitive and Physical Demands:

  • Daily: Extended periods of computer work, operational monitoring, data analysis, reporting, and communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Frequent: Application of professional judgment to prioritize operational issues, assess supply chain risks, coordinate corrective actions, and make decisions aligned with company policies and customer requirements.
  • Occasional: Walking through warehouse and distribution environments, including exposure to loading, receiving, shipping, and other operational areas.

Qualifications:

Must Have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Operations, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in supply chain, logistics, transportation, distribution, or warehouse operations
  • Strong experience managing or overseeing 3PL warehouse operations
  • Experience with U.S./Mexico cross-border logistics and supply chain operations preferred
  • Strong understanding of inventory management, order fulfillment, transportation, warehouse operations, and distribution
  • Experience supporting high-volume retail, distribution, or channel-driven business models preferred
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and Excel skills
  • Experience working with ERP, WMS, EDI, transportation management, and related supply chain systems
  • Strong vendor-management and partner-accountability skills
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and operational issues in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment
  • Strong ownership mindset with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues
  • English/Spanish bilingual capability required/preferred
  • Ability to work regularly across the El Paso/Juárez supply chain operation

Nice to Have:

  • Experience supporting major U.S. retailers or high-volume distribution environments
  • Experience managing cross-border operations between the United States and Mexico
  • Experience with consumer electronics or other high-volume, fast-moving product categories
  • Advanced Excel skills, including data analysis, reporting, and operational modeling
  • Experience with SAP, Oracle, or other enterprise ERP platforms
  • Experience with CTPAT/Trade compliance
  • Experience with WMS, EDI, ASN, BOL, and retailer-specific operational workflows
  • Experience with transportation management systems and carrier performance management
  • Experience leading process improvement, automation, or supply chain digitalization initiatives
  • Experience managing 3PL relationships and contract logistics providers
  • Strong understanding of retail compliance and customer-specific fulfillment requirements
  • Experience working in a global or cross-border organization, particularly supporting HQ teams based in Asia
  • Mandarin Chinese language proficiency

Benefits:

  • Vacation: Starting at 5 days per year
  • Health & Wellness Days: 10 days per year (prorated based on start date)
  • Paid Holidays: 12 days per year
  • Medical Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Matching
